reason: A is more testable because it specifies quasi-static loading, quantitative property-retention thresholds, a composition series, and an explicit rejection rule, while also acknowledging direct evidence that reducing Hf may weaken the alloy and that Al has previously degraded plasticity. Both proposals are incremental and may overpredict density reduction and single-phase stability, but B is vaguer and incorrectly treats conflicting Al-plasticity evidence as unqualified support.
